obsidianConfigPath.description: Optional custom path to obsidian.json. Defaults to ~/.config/obsidian/obsidian.json.

customVaults.description: Explicit custom vault definitions (paths or objects with name and path) to index.

ignoredDirectories.description: Additional folder names to ignore during note/image/document scanning (e.g. templates, archive). Hidden folders (.obsidian, .git, .trash) are always ignored.

includeMarkdown.description: Whether to discover and process markdown notes (.md).

includeImages.description: Whether to discover and process image files.

imageExtensions.description: Recognized image file extensions for image discovery.

includeDocuments.description: Discover and process document attachments in every configured vault through process-document.

documentExtensions.description: Document attachment extensions to discover. Markdown always uses the note pipeline. Formats must also be enabled in process-document.

documentRequestTimeoutMs.description: Whole message deadline per document, including worker parsing and optional chat summaries, in milliseconds.

atomicNoteCharLimit.description: Maximum character length for an atomic note (kept as a single whole-note chunk).

moderateNoteCharLimit.description: Character threshold separating moderate length notes from large notes.

moderateSnippetMaxChars.description: Max characters per paragraph snippet for moderate notes without headings.

largeNoteSnippetMaxChars.description: Max characters per paragraph snippet for large notes.

h3SubdivisionMinSectionChars.description: Minimum section character length before checking for H3 subdivisions in large notes.

h3SnippetSubdivisionMinChars.description: Minimum H3 subsection length before paragraph snippet splitting in large notes.

largeSectionSnippetMinChars.description: Minimum section length before paragraph snippet splitting in large notes.

expandAtomicNotes.description: Whether to expand atomic/short notes using the Chat model.

atomicNoteWordThreshold.description: Word count cutoff below which a note qualifies as short/atomic for expansion.

atomicNoteCharThreshold.description: Optional character length ceiling for note expansion.

targetTokens.description: Fixed target token count override for LLM expansion response.

dynamicTokenBase.description: Base allowance for dynamic target tokens formula: round(base + words * multiplier).

dynamicTokenMultiplier.description: Multiplier per word in dynamic target tokens formula.

dynamicTokenMin.description: Minimum allowed tokens in dynamic target tokens clamp.

dynamicTokenMax.description: Maximum allowed tokens in dynamic target tokens clamp.

chatPromptTemplate.description: Custom user prompt template for note expansion. Supports {{title}} and {{content}} placeholders.

chatSystemPrompt.description: Custom system prompt for note expansion. Supports {{targetTokens}} placeholder.
examples: You are a personal knowledge assistant. Expand the note concisely within {{targetTokens}} tokens.

chatTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for note expansion LLM queries.

describeImages.description: Whether to generate multimodal text descriptions for images using the Chat model.

imagePrompt.description: Custom prompt for multimodal image descriptions.
examples: Describe this image in detail, noting any text, diagrams, and visual structure.

imageSystemPrompt.description: Custom system prompt for multimodal image descriptions.
examples: You are an expert image analyst extracting knowledge from Obsidian vault attachments.

imageTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds for image description LLM queries.

fallbackDescriptionTemplate.description: Fallback text template when image description fails or runs offline. Supports {{imageName}} placeholder.

contextHydrationLimit.description: Number of prior chunks to hydrate for continuity context during file ingestion.

namespace.description: Namespace for sources, chunks, and graph elements.

forceAll.description: If true, forces reprocessing of all vault files, ignoring mtime watermarks.
